final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), above_average AS (SELECT member_count, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
